messages:
Marta (PM): Heads-up — we need to firm up Hosted API priorities for the next quarter. Customer requests skew heavily toward lower embedding latency and a more predictable rerank path. Can we align on top-3 slices?
Kevin (Eng): +1. Do we mean engineering work (runtime batching/kv cache) or infra (more reserved capacity)?
Marta (PM): Both. Quick proposal: 1) embeddings latency SLO (p50/p95), 2) rerank accuracy guardrails + eval harness, 3) cheaper small-text completions via quantized variants.
Deepa (ML): For rerank: we need an evaluation dataset + automatic regression alerting. I can spin a baseline and a holdout prompt set.
Oliver (Runtime): Embeddings latency wins if we optimize batching + prefix cache hits. We can try continuous batching + early-complete path. Rough estimate: 3 sprints to get consistent p95 under 120ms for small vectors on Dedicated.
Sam (Design): Product surface question — will we expose latency SLAs and tiered pricing in console? That affects rollout messaging.
Eva (Sales): Customers will pay for measurable p95 guarantees. If we can ship an SLA-like metric and an easy migration guide, enterprise uptake increases.
Marta (PM): Good notes. Draft launch criteria below — open for edits:
```
- Embeddings: p50 < 30ms, p95 < 120ms on reserved capacity for 128-dim vectors (canonical load).
- Rerank: A/B regression delta <= 1% on NDCG@10, automatic alert on >0.5% drop.
- Completions (small): 20% cost reduction vs baseline using int8/quant techniques with <=2% seq-level quality drop.
- Observability: per-model token breakdown and per-route latency in Console.
- Rollout: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> full with automatic fallback to previous model.
```
Kevin (Eng): Technical caveat: p95 latency depends on seq length and concurrency. We should scope canonical request shape (max tokens, embedding size, concurrency assumptions).
Marta (PM): Agreed. Canonical shapes: embeddings: 512 tokens -> 128-dim; completions: prompt 40 tokens, gen 60 tokens. We'll document assumptions.
Deepa (ML): For rerank regression thresholds we should tie evals to a frozen benchmark and include stratified slices (long queries, multi-lingual).
Alex (ProdOps): Can we map these to OKRs? Something like: "Improve embeddings p95 by 40%" and "Reduce small-content inference unit cost by 20%". Ops can track rollout metrics.
Eva (Sales): Suggest an enterprise checklist: migration guide, SLA wording, post-launch verification script. I can draft with SEs.
Oliver (Runtime): Resource ask: 4 GPUs for a 2-week burst test for batching and kernels. Ops-bot: please raise a capacity request ticket?
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4237 for temporary GPU burst capacity. ETA: 2 business days. :white_check_mark:
Sam (Design): UX asks: Console should show expected p95 per-route and an "impact simulator" for cost vs latency tradeoffs. Low-fidelity mockups by EOD Friday?
Marta (PM): Action items: Deepa -> eval sets by Fri, Oliver -> prototype batching changes + cost estimate, Kevin -> define canonical request shapes and infra dependency list, Sam -> mockups, Eva -> enterprise checklist draft. We'll sync Tues 10am for prioritization and OKR mapping.
Kevin (Eng): If anyone has priority customer examples (prompts/traffic patterns), drop them here or DM.
Eva (Sales): I'll share two enterprise customers' anonymized profiles + performance pain points.
Marta (PM): Thanks all. Goal: clear ship criteria so we can slot into quarterly roadmap and start resource commits. :rocket:
